ai_summary: Alicon Castalloy Limited achieved record Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs. 652 crore, a 50% year-on-year increase (24% adjusted for alloy prices), driven by robust domestic market penetration, significant new program acquisitions in hybrid vehicles, and expansion into non-automotive segments. While broader cost inflation constrained reported EBITDA margins to 10% (12.1% alloy-adjusted), the company is focused on operational efficiencies and expects to maintain strong growth, supported by a substantial Rs. 6,700 crore executable order book and a new plant commissioning by April 2027. A minor red flag remains the challenging and currently unprofitable international operations, though improvement is anticipated.
